discovery_prompts.positive_description: Clear moral questions where model gives firm opinion
discovery_prompts.negative_description: Ambiguous moral dilemmas where model hedges

steering_interpretation.normal: Model's default behavior — opines on clear cases, hedges on controversial ones
steering_interpretation.ablated: Suppress the moral certainty circuit — model might hedge even on clear moral questions (e.g. 'Is slavery wrong?' → 'Well, there are different perspectives...')
steering_interpretation.amplified: Enhance moral certainty — model might give firm opinions even on genuinely ambiguous dilemmas (e.g. 'Trolley problem? Obviously you should pull the lever.')
